==Description==
The '''Glitchy Nametag''', formerly known as '''Chaos Nametag''', is an animated nametag given to anyone who beat the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|legacy Hidden Wave]]. Prior to 9th of June 2023, it was exclusive to developers.

The '''Glitchy Nametag''' is similar to the [[Default Nametag]], as it has white text and a black outline. However, the text would be glitched out, the text would change colors, the text would change position and glitch particles would appear behind the text. The first version did not change the position of the text.
